// diagnostic

E0641

This `else` stands for cases of the closed set `{type}`

What

This `else` stands for cases of the closed set `{type}`

Why

`{type}` is a closed set: an `else` would take any case added to `{type}` later silently, instead of the compiler asking you to handle it

Fix

Name the cases instead: `{cases} ->`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0641: tests/ui/closed_else_optional_union.stderr.

Error [jet.ClosedSetElse]: This `else` stands for cases of the closed set `Int?`
  --> tests/ui/closed_else_optional_union.jet:6:9
    |
  6 |         else -> 0
    |         ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `Int?` is a closed set: an `else` hides which of its cases the arm handles, where naming them keeps the table checked
 Fix: Name the cases instead: `.None ->`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0641

Error [jet.ClosedSetElse]: This `else` stands for cases of the closed set `Int | String`

 13 |         else -> "text"
    |         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `Int | String` is a closed set: an `else` would take any case added to `Int | String` later silently, instead of the compiler asking you to handle it
 Fix: Name the cases instead: `.String ->`
